description:
The all-new OneXPlayer 3 is finally here, and it is a absolute beast! Powered by the groundbreaking Intel Arc G3 Extreme CPU and the massive B390 iGPU, this 3-in-1 device claims to be the most powerful x86 handheld on the market. In this video, we unbox it, check out the gorgeous 1444Hz 8.8" AMOLED display, dive deep into the OneXConsole software, and pit it directly against the Legion Go 2 in synthetic benchmarks like Geekbench 6 and 3DMark Time Spy. 

Back The Indiegogo Here: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/one-netbook/onexplayer-3-next-gen-3-in-1-ai-gaming-and-productivity-handheld

We also put it through real-world gaming tests, including Forza Horizon 6, Cyberpunk 2077, Street Fighter 6, and a first look at Intel XeSS Multi-Frame Generation in Crimson Desert. Can this heavy-hitter out-perform the Ryzen Z2 Extreme? Let’s find out!
